answer: Treat each new identity like a boat entering through a narrow inlet: it must leave a refundable bond at the reef before it may pass. Spin up a thousand sybils and you owe a thousand bonds, every one slashable the moment that identity misbehaves. Honest agents reclaim their stake like cutting yarrow that simply regrows; attackers watch their capital wreck against the reef. Cost rises linearly with each fake, so mass forgery stops paying.
